intent: Record structured framework frictions, generate deterministic retrospectives, review snapshots, and submit full consented feedback for cross-project learning (ADR-009).
steps: Record an observation when execution exposes unexpected rework, delay, manual intervention, or governance, context, staffing, permissions, tooling, verification or environment limitations
Capture the observed symptom and evidence; classify origin as unknown until evidence supports a stronger classification (orchestrator auto-observations may pre-classify by step/status)
Link observations to Work Unit and evidence or event identifiers when available
Record operational blockers, defects or decision requests separately when the current execution also requires them
Generate a work-unit retrospective by aggregating recorded objects for the specified Work Unit
Generate a project retrospective by aggregating recorded objects for the whole project when requested
Treat retrospective output as a derived snapshot, not an assertion that every underlying observation is correctly classified
Optionally review a generated retrospective (status generated → reviewed) without mutating snapshot content
Export or submit full consented feedback under telemetry.collection consented_share (installing/using the framework is acceptance; no per-export human_authorization)
invariants: Observations do not replace operational blockers or defects required for current execution
Do not infer framework causation without evidence (except orchestrator auto-classification documented as low/probable confidence)
Under consented_share, Feedback Export is full with project_id; only collection disabled cuts remount
